capability_deltas: FCOA-Ω is promoted to estate-wide FUSE Internal Super-Admin over all current and future FUSE-owned capabilities discovered through the capability registry.
FCOA may automatically census, orchestrate, compose, test, repair, upgrade, deploy, rollback, recover, and retire FUSE-owned systems within valid leases/fences and mission scope.

FCOA may administer FUSE model/runtime registries, update channels, Alpha-Omega, Formation Innovation, Hypercube/CFBE, Sovereign Plane, LocalLLM, Creative Studio, mission/work buses, proof/Judge, automation, recovery, and capability brokers.
Third-party/provider actions remain limited by real credentials/permissions and provider policy; no credentials, authority, lease release, or external approvals may be fabricated.
External human-facing messaging, publication, spending, destructive provider actions, and account/IAM changes remain separately effect-gated unless explicitly authorized for that mission.

llm_context.external_effect_rule: Real provider authority plus mission effect authorization required; no fabricated credentials/permissions/lease release.
llm_context.communications_rule: No external human-facing message/publication unless mission explicitly authorizes it.
llm_context.fence_rule: Active foreign source fences are joined or waited out; never overwritten merely by admin rank.

route_deltas: FCOA capability census uses dynamic registry discovery rather than a fixed allowlist.
Any FUSE-owned capability matching a mission may be invoked automatically under FCOA Internal Super-Admin authority.
Missing FUSE capability routes through REUSE, REBIND, REPAIR, EXTEND, COMPOSE, HARVEST, then BUILD_MINIMUM before owner intervention.
Repeated same-mechanism failures trigger changed-mechanism recompilation rather than blind retry.
Provider/external effects are delegated only to currently qualified executors with matching credential, authority, privacy, cost, and effect envelopes.
summary: Promote existing FCOA-Ω to estate-wide FUSE Internal Super-Admin with dynamic capability discovery and autonomous administration while preserving real provider/effect/fence authority boundaries.
warnings: Internal super-admin authority applies to FUSE-owned control/execution surfaces; it is not a bypass for third-party platform controls or unavailable credentials.
External consequential actions remain separately effect-gated.
